For a large enterprise organisation in the Netherlands, we are looking for a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer to join a small engineering team building an innovative AI-native application from the ground up.

The goal is to develop an agentic application that can take business and technical requirements, gather the right context, identify missing or conflicting information, generate technical artifacts and code, and validate the output against requirements and organisational controls.

You will help build the complete application around the AI models, including:

Designing human-AI interactions for gathering requirements, resolving ambiguity and reviewing generated outputs.
Building the full web application across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations and application services.
Engineering AI harnesses and orchestration layers that connect models with enterprise context, tools, execution environments and validation mechanisms.
Developing iterative AI workflows where the system can generate, test, validate, correct and explain its outputs.
Building mechanisms for context retrieval and context engineering across enterprise data sources.
Integrating automated testing, CI/CD feedback, data-quality checks and organisational controls into AI workflows.
Maintaining traceability between requirements, retrieved context, generated artifacts, validation results and user decisions.
Contributing to security, observability, maintainability and production readiness.
Working closely with architecture, data engineering and platform specialists.




The profile we are looking for

We are looking for a medior-senior to senior engineer, ideally with 5+ years of software engineering experience, who enjoys working across the full technology stack.

You are not purely a frontend or backend engineer. You are comfortable moving between application architecture, Python services, React interfaces, AI orchestration and cloud infrastructure.




Ideally you bring:

Strong Python development experience.
Solid React / modern frontend development experience.
Experience building enterprise web applications from scratch.
Strong API, backend and application-service development experience.
Experience with LLMs, Agentic AI or AI orchestration.
Understanding of AI harnesses, tool calling, context retrieval and validation loops.
Experience designing effective human-AI interactions and UX.
Experience with Azure.
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform and/or Bicep.
Experience with CI/CD and modern software-engineering practices.
Understanding of security, privacy, IAM, auditability and operational reliability in enterprise environments.




Experience in any of the following would be highly valuable:

AI-assisted code generation.
Agentic workflows or multi-step AI systems.
Evaluation frameworks, guardrails or AI quality mechanisms.
Secure execution and validation of AI-generated code.
RAG / context engineering.
Requirements traceability.
Policy-as-code or automated control validation.
Data contracts, schemas, metadata or data-product concepts.
GitHub Copilot or comparable AI-assisted development tools.
Building products in a regulated enterprise environment.




The work will roughly combine:

30% AI / Agentic Engineering

30% Frontend / UX

40% Backend / Platform Engineering

There is therefore a slight emphasis on backend engineering, but you should be comfortable contributing across the entire application.

We are looking for someone with an entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset.

The team operates within a large enterprise organisation, but the project itself needs the pace and ownership of a startup. You should therefore be comfortable navigating enterprise requirements while still finding practical ways to move quickly.

You enjoy working with incomplete requirements, asking the right questions and turning ambiguity into working software. You understand that the AI model itself is only one part of an AI-native product and that reliable outcomes depend on context, orchestration, UX, validation, controls and feedback loops.

You will join a small senior engineering squad supported by a Product Manager. The team is being built around complementary engineering strengths, so collaboration and shared technical decision-making are important.




This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, not a people-management position. It is a particularly interesting opportunity for an engineer who wants to move beyond traditional Full Stack development and help build a production-grade Agentic AI application from its earliest stages.

Senior Test Automation Engineer

Rotterdam, Netherlands, 5 days a week

Up to €5500 monthly + benefits




Are you passionate about building robust automated testing frameworks that enable high-quality software delivery at scale? This is an opportunity to take ownership of a critical test automation function within a fast-growing, technology-led business investing heavily in AI-driven engineering practices. You'll play a key role in ensuring rapid development cycles can progress safely, reliably, and efficiently.




The Company

They are a high-growth digital business with an international team focused on building and scaling innovative technology platforms. With significant investment in modern engineering practices, AI-enabled development workflows, and continuous delivery, they are creating an environment where technology teams can move quickly while maintaining exceptional quality standards.

Working in a collaborative and ambitious culture, you'll have the opportunity to influence technical direction, improve engineering standards, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of a modern software platform.




The Role

As a Senior Test Automation Engineer, you will take ownership of automated testing architecture and quality assurance processes across a complex platform environment.

Responsibilities include:

Designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end automated test frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript
Establishing API and contract testing strategies to ensure reliability across services and integrations
Defining quality standards and testing requirements early in the development lifecycle
Optimising CI/CD pipelines to deliver fast, reliable feedback to engineering teams
Developing automated regression testing to reduce production risk and improve platform resilience
Working closely with software engineers and product teams to embed quality throughout the development process
Supporting best practices in automated testing, integration testing, and quality engineering
Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across engineering processes and tooling




Your Skills & Experience

You will bring:

Strong commercial experience in software test automation within modern web application environments
Hands-on expertise with Playwright, TypeScript, or JavaScript
Experience building and maintaining end-to-end testing frameworks
Knowledge of API testing, contract testing, REST services, and JSON-based integrations
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, including GitHub Actions or similar tooling
Understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and automated quality assurance practices
Ability to work autonomously and take ownership of technical solutions
A collaborative approach with strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
Interest in AI-enabled software development and modern engineering practice




What They Offer

Salary of €4,500 - €6,000 per month
The opportunity to own and shape a critical quality engineering function
Exposure to modern AI-assisted development environments
Clear opportunities for professional growth and progression
A collaborative, international technology team
Comprehensive benefits package, including wellness and lifestyle benefits
The chance to make a visible impact within a scaling technology business




How to Apply
